# UNS Energy

> UNS Energy Corporation operates Tucson Electric Power, a major utility serving Arizona with a focus on sustainability, renewable energy integration, and ESG performance.

UNS Energy is a subsidiary of Fortis Inc. and operates through its primary brand Tucson Electric Power (TEP), serving the Tucson region and broader North American markets. The company prioritizes climate strategy, carbon emissions reduction, and corporate responsibility in its operations.
